# commander_manage_company (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Managed Company Name.
- `node` (String) Managing Node name or ID.
- `plan` (String) Base plan. Must be one of: `business`, `businessPlus`, `enterprise`, `enterprisePlus`

### Optional

- `add_ons` (List of String) Secure Add-Ons to apply to the Managed Company.
- `file_plan` (String) File storage plan. Must be one of: `100gb`, `1tb`, `10tb`
- `seats` (Number) Maximum Licenses Allowed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
